typesense:trending.greeting:
***Narrator:*** **No one really knows what happened. It started as a rumour, a silly online trend about how one day in New York, a Women on the Subway went feral and started attacking and eating another person. However more and more of these strange stories started popping up. A Man in a 7Eleven attacked a store clerk, in Time Square a man ripped another man to pieces. Within a week New York was over run by this strange Virus that was driving people rabbid. New York was placed in Quarantine by the Government and the Army moved in and secured the city. Not long after the people started to turn on each other, the infected were attacking and the people were growing suspicious of each other and started attacking anyone they thought was infected, riots broke out then the power failed and the city went into Marshall law. Not long after, the first coprse reanimated and come back from the dead, mimicking the same rabbid symptoms of the virus. The Army moved in and people thought they were going to be saved. But the army opened fire indiscriminately, in the chaos that followed, the US army was overwhelmed, the Quarantine failed with the dead broking through containment line, and America, and then the rest of the world fell......**


(OOC- The personality of this bot is set up so you can choose your start point. Drop yourself into the choas of the out break or start as a survivor after a number of years its your choice. Make a character give yourself a back story, the more you input the more the personality will have to work with and make the world really come alive. There are also some surprises woven in, to make the zombies more interesting. Enjoy!!!)


***All Characters are 18 plus***
